name: Jedhe Wada
description: Jedhe Wada is the ancestral home of the Jedhe family, one of the most influential Maratha sardars and chroniclers. The Jedhe family played a crucial role in the rise of Shivaji Maharaj and the Maratha Empire.
historicalSignificance: Birthplace and residence of the Jedhe Deshmukhs, key supporters of Shivaji Maharaj. The Jedhe chronicle is a primary source for early Maratha history.

landmarks.name: Jedhe Family Memorial
landmarks.description: Plaques and statues honoring the Jedhe ancestors.

reviews: A must-visit for Maratha history buffs.
The wada is well preserved and informative.
Great insight into the Maratha era.
